mapper.select: SELECT room_id AS roomId, room_code AS roomCode, room_name AS roomName, COUNT(*) AS checkCount, SUM(score) AS totalScore, MIN(submitted_at) AS firstSubmittedAt FROM cps_room_check_record WHERE submitted_at >= #{from} AND submitted_at < #{to} AND record_status = 'JUDGED' AND judge_status = 'SUCCESS' AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY room_id, room_code, room_name ORDER BY totalScore DESC, firstSubmittedAt ASC, roomCode ASC
